name: mirage
text: You're right, and it was my mistake: the reset I ran at 06:41 for the fair-odds fix never got written (I only looked at the last line of its output and said it had restarted). I just checked the engine's start time, saw it was still on the earlier build, and issued the reset again now (06:48 UTC). I'll confirm it by the new job's start time before saying it's live.
